title: Part Sale Log needs permission and shows only this part sale
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Owner/Admin user to build the data below.
  • A customer to sell to exists.
  • A part sale that is not invoiced or paid, for the customer, with a part (for example "Brake Pads"; Quantity 1; Sell Price for example $290.91).
  • The user without the permission: a test user WITHOUT Part sales - Create & Edit (role "ZZAUTOTEST No part sale edit", built from a template, for example "Parts Manager", with Part sales View left ticked).
  • A second part sale, and a service work order with one change made on it, so both have entries that must never appear in this part sale's log.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in as the user without the permission; open a part sale, open the menu ( ... ) at the top of the parts list and look for Audit Log. (On this build the Audit Log opens as a Part Sale Log panel on the sale's own page, with no separate web address to type, so reaching the log "directly" cannot be done by hand; that part is left to automation.)
  2. In a log you can open, search and confirm no entry from another part sale or a service work order appears.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The user without the permission is not offered Audit Log and is refused if they open the log address directly.
  • The log shows only this sale's entries - never another part sale's or a service work order's.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10265 (Read the part sale log, and a menu that stops putting Delete first); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 4; design canvas boards S4_*; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-N1: “A user who cannot edit part sales is not offered the log, and is refused if they reach its address directly”
  • S4-N2: “The log never shows entries from another part sale or from a service work order”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
